subject: [PATCH v3 12/14] selftests/nfsd: add a per-netns rpcbind stub and the listener round-trips

2026-08-28.patch_summary: This patch adds a per-network namespace (netns) rpcbind stub to the selftests/nfsd test suite. The stub serves rpcbind from within the netns, allowing tests to register listeners and round-trip requests without relying on the host's rpcbind service. This is necessary because a fresh netns has no rpcbind service, causing registration failures and timeouts. The patch also includes new tests that cover various scenarios, including listener creation, addition, removal, and IPv6 support.
